evidence.quote: Relying on AI-detection tools to penalise students risks false accusations, unfair treatment, and a breakdown of trust between staff and students. While plagiarism checkers help enforce clear rules, AI detectors operate in a grey area where “false positives” are common and untestable. Using them as a policing mechanism is therefore neither effective nor equitable in way of upholding assessment integrity. Instead, it is recommended that educators focus on adapting assessments to be more AI-resilient.

claims.claimText: Teaching Support warns that relying on AI detectors to penalise students risks false accusations; use appropriate authenticity checks and Board procedures. This is not a university ban on detectors.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Relying on AI-detection tools to penalise students risks false accusations, unfair treatment, and a breakdown of trust between staff and students. While plagiarism checkers help enforce clear rules, AI detectors operate in a grey area where “false positives” are common and untestable. Using them as a policing mechanism is therefore neither effective nor equitable in way of upholding assessment integrity. Instead, it is recommended that educators focus on adapting assessments to be more AI-resilient.

academic_integrity.en: ME2026/27 BSc/MSc Article7 covers AI output presented as one’s own through deception, carelessness or inadequate referencing. The programme Board of Examiners handles suspected fraud; students can respond orally/in writing before a finding/sanction, except no hearing is required if no fraud is found. No result/annulment normally follows fraud, with exceptional cases; further sanctions are case-specific. An appealable examiner/Board decision can be challenged before CBE within six weeks starting the day after the decision was announced/sent. Pro-forma appeals and exceptional non-culpable lateness have separate conditions; check the actual decision and appealability.
academic_integrity.zh: ME2026/27本科及硕士第7条涵盖欺骗、疏忽或引注不足而冒认AI作品。项目考试委员会处理，认定或处分前有口头或书面回应机会，无舞弊则可免听证。通常不计或撤销成绩但保留例外，追加处分按个案。可申诉的教师或考试委员会决定向CBE申诉，六周从决定公告或发送的次日起算。简式申诉及不可归责逾期另有条件，须核对实际决定及可申诉性。
